# American Sport and Fitness Association (ASFA)

> > ASFA provides comprehensive online fitness certifications for personal trainers, group fitness instructors, wellness coaches, and specialized fitness professionals.

ASFA is a leading provider of online fitness certifications and professional credentials, partnering with Human Kinetics and Insure Fitness Group. The platform offers entry-level through master-level certifications across multiple fitness disciplines with study materials, online exams, and continuing education support.

## Key Topics

- Personal Trainer Certification (CPT)
- Group Fitness & Bootcamp Instructor Certification
- Health & Wellness Coach Certification
- Sport Psychology Coach Certification
- Strength & Conditioning Coach Certification
- Water Aerobics Instructor Certification
- Online Certification Programs
- Advanced & Master Certifications
- Fitness Professional's Handbook
- Certification Renewals
- Professional Credentials
- Online Exams
- Continuing Education
- Certification Downloads
- Fitness Professional Development

## Core Certifications

- [Personal Trainer Certification Online | ASFA](https://www.americansportandfitness.com/products/personal-trainer-certification): Personal Trainer Certification (CPT) online exam and program details
- [Group Fitness Certification Online | Bootcamp Instructor](https://www.americansportandfitness.com/products/group-fitness-bootcamp-certification): Group Fitness & Bootcamp Instructor Certification with study materials
- [Health and Wellness Coach Certification Online | ASFA](https://www.americansportandfitness.com/products/health-wellness-coach-certification): Health & Wellness Coach Certification for lifestyle and well-being professionals
- [Sport Psychology Coach Certification Online | ASFA](https://www.americansportandfitness.com/products/sport-psychology-certification): Sport Psychology Coach Certification for mental performance coaching
- [Strength & Conditioning Certification Online | ASFA](https://www.americansportandfitness.com/products/strength-conditioning-certification): Strength & Conditioning Coach Certification for athletic performance
- [Water Aerobics Certification Online | ASFA](https://www.americansportandfitness.com/products/water-aerobics-certification): Water Aerobics Instructor Certification for aquatic exercise leadership

## Certification Collections

- [Online Personal Trainer Certifications | ASFA](https://www.americansportandfitness.com/collections/personal-trainer-certifications): Personal trainer certification collection with basic, advanced, and master levels
- [Group Fitness and Bootcamp Certifications Online | ASFA](https://www.americansportandfitness.com/collections/group-fitness-certifications): Group fitness and bootcamp instructor certifications at multiple levels
- [Fitness and Wellness Coaching Certifications Online | ASFA](https://www.americansportandfitness.com/collections/coaching-certifications): Health, wellness, and weight loss coaching certifications for professionals
- [Advanced and Master Fitness Certifications Online | ASFA](https://www.americansportandfitness.com/collections/advanced-certifications): Master and advanced certification programs for experienced fitness professionals
- [Personal Trainer & Fitness Certifications Online | ASFA](https://www.americansportandfitness.com/collections/fitness-certifications): Main fitness certification collection with personal trainer and specialty programs
- [Trending Fitness Certifications Online | ASFA](https://www.americansportandfitness.com/collections/trending-certifications): In-demand fitness certifications curated for current market trends
